firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently defended a person or an honorable cause takes the first turn. Continue clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: A turn begins with the Horde phase, followed by the Hero phase.
For fewer than four players, each person chooses one Hero; unused Horde boards become neutral boards. In a two-player game, the two Hero boards must face each other.
